primary.title: ‘Less exciting long-term savings crucial for financial security in old age’: CEA encourages pension investment
primary.summary: CEA Nageswaran urged Indians to prioritise long-term savings over short-term trading, highlighting the importance of pension assets for financial security. He noted pension assets are only 17% of GDP, significantly lower than OECD peers, indicating room for growth.
